messages.content:
You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value, sometimes a condition, and the place it comes from.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the facts, step by step: a repeal or a
  limit "from 20 January" does not yet apply on 16 January.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the facts.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Can the UR5e robot arm be put into service on its own, as delivered by the manufacturer?

Facts:
[0] autonomous mobile machinery or related products — mustAccompany — instructions for use (instructions for use) [REG, Annex III, 3.6.3.3]
[1] Autonomous mobile machinery — definedAs — has an autonomous mode (has an autonomous mode) [condition: all essential safety functions ensured without permanent interaction of an operator] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[2] control system — requiresMeasure — designed to perform the safety functions by itself (designed to perform the safety functions by itself) [condition: For autonomous mobile machinery or related product; even when actions are ordered by using a remote supervisory function] [REG, Annex III, 3.3]
[3] self-propelled machinery travelling function — requiresMeasure — an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device (an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device) [condition: Where safety so requires, in the event of a failure of the main device, or in the absence of the energy supply needed to actuate the main device] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.3]
[4] remote-controlled machinery — requiresMeasure — will respond only to signals from the intended control units (will respond only to signals from the intended control units) [REG, Annex III, 3.3]
[5] putting into service — definedAs — means the first use, for its intended purpose, in the Community (means the first use, for its intended purpose, in the community) [DIR, Art. 2]
[6] self-propelled machinery — requiresMeasure — an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device (an emergency device with a fully independent and easily accessible control device) [condition: Where safety so requires, in the event of a failure of the main device, or in the absence of the energy supply needed to actuate the main device] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.3]
[7] lifting machinery or related products — mustAccompany — instructions for use (instructions for use) [REG, Annex III, 4.4.2]
[8] putting into service — definedAs — the first use, for its intended purpose, in the Union (the first use, for its intended purpose, in the union) [REG, Art. 3(13)]
[9] autonomous mobile machinery — requiresMeasure — supervisory function specific to the autonomous mode (supervisory function specific to the autonomous mode) [condition: Where relevant] [REG, Annex III, 3.2.4]
[10] remote controlled machinery — requiresMeasure — designed and constructed in such a way that it will respond only to signals from the intended control units (designed and constructed in such a way that it will respond only to signals from the intended control units) [DIR, Annex I, 3.3]
[11] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (vehicle servicing lifts) [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 3]
[12] vehicle servicing lifts — listedIn — Vehicle servicing lifts (annex IV point 16) [DIR, Annex IV]
[13] machinery not assembled on manufacturer's premises — mustAccompany — the necessary instructions for performing the measures (instructions for performing measures referred to in section 4.1.3) [condition: for machinery which is not assembled on the premises of the manufacturer in the form in which it is to be used] [DIR, Annex I, 4.4.2]
[14] partly completed machinery — mustAccompany — accompanied by the assembly instructions (accompanied by the assembly instructions) [REG, Art. 14(4)]
[15] partly completed machinery — mustAccompany — accompanied by the assembly instructions (accompanied by the assembly instructions) [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[16] manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative — hasObligation — shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that (shall, before placing it on the market, ensure that) [condition: before placing it on the market] [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[17] importers — hasObligation — shall ensure that the partly completed machinery is accompanied by the assembly instructions (shall ensure that the partly completed machinery is accompanied by the assembly instructions) [REG, Art. 14(4)]
[18] self-propelled machinery with ride-on driver — requiresMeasure — appropriate protective structure (appropriate protective structure) [condition: unless this increases the risk] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.3]
[19] self-propelled machinery with ride-on person(s) — requiresMeasure — appropriate protective structure (appropriate protective structure) [condition: if its size allows] [DIR, Annex I, 3.4.4]
[20] manufacturer or authorised representative — hasObligation — must ensure (must ensure) [condition: When lifting machinery or lifting accessories are placed on the market or are first put into service] [DIR, Annex I, 4.1.3]
[21] the manufacturer — hasObligation — the appropriate measures shall be taken at the place of use by the manufacturer (the appropriate measures shall be taken at the place of use by the manufacturer) [condition: Where the machinery or related products cannot be assembled in the manufacturer’s premises] [REG, Annex III, 4.1.3]
[22] partly completed machinery — hasObligation — must not be put into service (must not be put into service) [condition: until the final machinery into which it is to be incorporated has been declared in conformity with the provisions of this Directive, where appropriate] [DIR, Annex II, 1]
[23] manufacturer — hasObligation — provide the assembly instructions in paper format free of charge within one month (provide the assembly instructions in paper format free of charge within one month) [condition: at the request of the person who incorporates the partly completed machinery at the time of purchase] [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[24] lifting machinery — mustAccompany — must be accompanied by instructions (instructions) [DIR, Annex I, 4.4.2]
[25] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — bears at least the designation of the partly completed machinery (bears at least the designation of the partly completed machinery) [REG, Art. 11(5)]
[26] machinery with embedded self-evolving ML systems ensuring safety functions — listedIn — 6. (annex I, part A, point 6) [condition: in respect only of those systems] [REG, Annex I, Part A, point 6]
[27] remote-controlled machinery — requiresMeasure — appropriate means to signal its movements (appropriate means to signal its movements) [condition: under normal conditions of use, exposes persons to the risk of impact or crushing] [REG, Annex III, 3.6.1]
[28] self-propelled machinery travel movements — requiresMeasure — the driver is at the controls (the driver is at the controls) [condition: with a ride-on driver] [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.2]
[29] self-propelled machinery travelling function — requiresMeasure — a main device (a main device) [DIR, Annex I, 3.3.3]
[30] essential requirement 1.1.5, machinery moved by hand — requiresMeasure — be equipped for picking up and moving safely (be equipped for picking up and moving safely) [condition: Where machinery or a related product or one of its component parts is to be moved by hand] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.5]
[31] starting of machinery — requiresMeasure — only by voluntary actuation of a control device provided for the purpose (only by voluntary actuation of a control device provided for the purpose) [DIR, Annex I, 1.2.3]
[32] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — be made available to the competent national authorities (be made available to the competent national authorities) [condition: Where relevant; upon a reasoned request; if that source code or programming logic is necessary in order for them to be able to check compliance] [REG, Art. 11(3)]
[33] digital assembly instructions made accessible online — retentionPeriod — for at least 10 years (P10Y) [condition: after the placing on the market of the partly completed machinery] [REG, Art. 11(7)]
[34] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed (shall ensure that it has been designed and constructed) [condition: When placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 11(1)]
[35] importers of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall place only compliant partly completed machinery (shall place only compliant partly completed machinery) [REG, Art. 14(1)]
[36] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use — becomesManufacturer — shall not be considered to be a manufacturer (shall not be considered to be a manufacturer) [condition: for his or her own use] [REG, Art. 18]
[37] Machinery or related products presenting risks due to their mobility — definedAs — operatedwithout being moved (operatedwithout being moved) [condition: machinery operated without being moved but which may be equipped to be moved more easily] [REG, Annex III, 3.1]
[38] manufacturer or his authorised representative — hasObligation — shall ensure that the procedure referred to in Article 13 has been completed (shall ensure that the procedure referred to in article 13 has been completed) [condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 5(2)]
[39] non-professional user modifying machinery for own use — hasObligation — shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out in Article 10 (shall not be subject to the obligations on the manufacturer set out in article 10) [condition: for his or her own use] [REG, Art. 18]
[40] machinery — mustAccompany — instructions for use (instructions for use) [REG, Annex III, 1.7.4.2]
[41] manufacturer of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — assembly instructions described in Annex VI are prepared (assembly instructions described in annex vi are prepared) [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[42] self-propelled machinery with a ride-on driver, travel movements — requiresMeasure — only if the driver is at the controls (only if the driver is at the controls) [condition: self-propelled machinery with a ride-on driver] [REG, Annex III, 3.3.2]
[43] distributors of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall make sure that the corrective actions (shall make sure that the corrective actions) [condition: who consider or have reason to believe that partly completed machinery which they have made available on the market is not in conformity with this Regulation] [REG, Art. 16(5)]
[44] self-propelled machinery running on rails for use in underground work — requiresMeasure — enabling device (enabling device) [condition: movement is stopped if the driver is no longer in control of the movement] [REG, Annex III, 5.4]
[45] ride-on self-propelled machinery — requiresMeasure — appropriate protective structure (appropriate protective structure) [condition: if its size allows] [REG, Annex III, 3.4.4]
[46] 4.1.2.2 machinery running on guide rails — requiresMeasure — devices, which act on the guide rails (devices, which act on the guide rails) [REG, Annex III, 4.1.2.2]
[47] distributors of partly completed machinery — hasObligation — shall act with due care (shall act with due care) [condition: When making partly completed machinery available on the market] [REG, Art. 16(1)]
[48] manufacturer of the machinery — hasObligation — the appropriate guard(s) must be provided by the manufacturer (provide the appropriate guard(s)) [condition: where necessary] [DIR, Annex I, 2.2.2.1]
[49] essential requirement 1.1.5, machinery too heavy to move by hand — requiresMeasure — be fitted with attachments for lifting gear (be fitted with attachments for lifting gear) [condition: Where the weight, size or shape of machinery or a related product or its various component parts prevents it or them from being moved by hand] [REG, Annex III, 1.1.5]

response.text: {"kind":"unknown","value":null,"text":"The facts say nothing about the UR5e or about robot arms, so they do not show whether it is partly completed machinery. If it is, Annex II, 1 of the Directive says partly completed machinery must not be put into service until the final machinery it is incorporated into has been declared in conformity. I cannot confirm that classification from these facts.","used":[22]}
